correctness.rationale: The residue proof is exact: for \(P=2a+c\), \(y\equiv ha\pmod P\) is a bijective residue coordinate, the small state is uniquely rounded up exactly for \(0<y<P/3\), and both large states are uniquely rounded up exactly for \(2P/3<y<P\). Consecutive-residue comparison yields \((P+3c)/6<y<P/3\). The embedded dual-arithmetic checker returns VERIFY_OK on 489 primitive pairs.
